messages.author: 4f04313c0a6b0f2f
messages.subject: Re: App error 502 Bad Gateway
parts:
Carson,

I didn't do anything to that :-)... Since I had already deployed the app in a blog post, I ended up tweaking the code to run it from the older glimmer server. During the time I had that error, there was another of my app on shinyapps.io that had the same error. My suspicion is that there were some changes being made on the server which caused the problem. 

That said, did you try deploying a dummy app to test if it was a problem with the code of the specific app or whether it might be an issue with the account or the server. One way to test if the issue was with the server could be to give us the code so that one could deploy it on the site and check if it worked from a different user's account.

Best,
Vivek
